reader_identity_mirror: Planner partner and impulse partner recognize themselves instantly.
emotional_obstacle: They move at different speeds: one needs certainty before action, the other needs action before certainty.
aachu_proof: She starts, speaks out loud, follows instinct, and turns the plan into the plot.
zuv_active_role: He plans, saves screenshots, worries silently, steadies objects and logistics, and chooses to join the motion instead of shrinking it.
bridge: The joke starts as opposite zodiac energy, then turns into a tender proof that love does not need identical temperaments.
earned_ending: Somehow, they make perfect sense because each gives the other's energy somewhere safe to go.
send_save_reason: People can tag the planner or starter in their relationship without needing private Aachu/Zuv context.
